Dear Tom,
I am sorry to hear that you are under great pressure and can't sleep well at night. Here are some suggestions that may help you.
First, you should plan your time carefully and avoid leaving tasks until the last minute. Second, doing some exercise for half an hour before bed, such as jogging or stretching, can help you relax. Third, try not to use screens an hour before sleep; reading a book instead may help you fall asleep more easily.
I hope these suggestions will be useful to you. Best wishes!
Yours,
Li Hua

answers.eng_wr_hs1_0046:
Dear David,
I'm glad to know you are interested in the Spring Festival, the most important traditional festival in China. It falls on the first day of the lunar calendar.

Before the festival, people put up Spring Festival couplets on doors and set off fireworks to welcome the new year. On New Year's Eve, the whole family gathers together for a big dinner, which is called "Nian Ye Fan". Children receive red packets with lucky money inside, which bring them good wishes.

I sincerely invite you to come to my hometown and spend the Spring Festival with my family. I'm sure you will have an unforgettable experience.

Yours,
Li Hua

Good afternoon, everyone!
My topic today is "Persistence and Dreams". I believe a clear dream gives us direction, while persistence turns the dream into reality. Without hard work, even the brightest dream will only remain an idea.
Here are my suggestions. First, set a clear and realistic goal for yourself. Second, break the big goal into small steps and celebrate each small success. Third, never give up when you face difficulties; remember that every failure is a step closer to success.
Let's hold on to our dreams and keep moving forward. Thank you!

Paragraph 1: The old man took the money with great gratitude. Tears welled up in his eyes as he held Tom's small hands in his. He told the boy that he used to be a teacher, but now he had lost his job and his home, and he had not eaten anything for two whole days. "You are the kindest person I have ever met," he said in a trembling voice. Tom felt both sad and proud. The cold wind seemed less bitter, and the two shared a moment of warmth on the cold street.

Paragraph 2: When Tom arrived home and told his mother what he had done, she was silent for a moment. Then she hugged him tightly and said with tears in her eyes, "My dear, the best present you can give me is to grow into a kind and generous person like this." That evening, Tom's mother cooked a small cake with the family, and they celebrated not only her birthday but also Tom's act of kindness together.
